name: circuit-board
title: Circuit Board
description: A dark band of hairline circuit traces with coloured pulses converging on a raised Powered By chip, over three rounded cards that fade in with icons and short descriptions.
use: A developer product wants a technology or integration section with a schematic feel and named cards below.
avoid: Small screens or print: the hairline traces and coloured pulses largely vanish at low resolution.
a11y: The circuit graphic has a descriptive label and cards are real links, but the looping pulses ignore reduced-motion preferences. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Fine right-angled circuit traces spread across the top half of a black stage, a few of them tinted orange, blue and pink. They meet at a small raised grey chip lettered Powered By. Below sit three dark rounded cards, each with a coloured icon, a title and an arrow, then two or three lines of grey copy.
behaves: Bright dots and gradient pulses run along the traces toward and away from the chip on endless loops. The cards rise and sharpen into place in sequence, and each card carries a slow pulsing border glow that lifts on hover.
customise: Card names, copy, links, icons and glow colours are written inside the component, so changing them means editing the file; the trace layout and pulse gradients are also in the source.
weight: moderate: Continuous SVG and CSS animation on a handful of traces plus three card springs.
